name: Chapter 40. Public employee trust fund
scope: chapter Wis. Stat. ch. 40 (Legislative Reference Bureau, chapter pages)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person
notice.quote: If it is determined that an applicant is eligible, the department of workforce development shall notify the department of employee trust funds and shall certify the applicant’s monthly salary.

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote: An employee may appeal a determination under par.
appeal.quote_through: The board shall consider the appeal and mail a report of its decision to the employee and the participating employer or state agency.

access.label: The person can see the record

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects
self-report.quote: The secretary shall submit a quarterly report to the employee trust funds board on decisions made under this paragraph.

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: 854.04 (6) shall not apply to a determination under this subsection.
